name: Mennet Carkad
summary: In the Undercity, Marion Call sends you to report to Mennet Carkad. He waits deep in the Rogues' Quarter, where promising operatives are tested for the Deathstalkers.

sections.title: A Summons from the Shadows
sections.body: Marion Call has a summons for you from Mennet Carkad. In the Undercity, covert operatives draw the notice of higher leadership, and Marion passes along word when a scout or assassin is invited to report. The Forsaken's intelligence apparatus has a lethal reputation, so ignoring its orders is no real choice.

sections.title: Joining the Deathstalkers
sections.body: Mennet Carkad waits in the Rogues' Quarter, watching recruits and judging whether they are ready. Those who answer his call are tested for entry into the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's feared arm of espionage and assassination. Obedience is the first test for anyone who seeks to serve the Dark Lady from the shadows.

faq.answer: Mennet Carkad trains rogues and handles Deathstalkers in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter. He oversees promising covert agents and assigns critical work for the Forsaken leadership.

faq.q: What happens if someone ignores Mennet Carkad's summons?
aliases: what happens if you ignore summons
faq.answer: Marion Call warns that you would not want to know what happened to those who ignored Carkad's call. She does not explain their exact fate.

The Deathstalkers are an elite order of rogues, spies, and assassins who serve the Forsaken. From the shadows of the Undercity, they eliminate high-value targets, gather intelligence, and defend Lordaeron from enemies such as the Scarlet Crusade and the Scourge.

faq.q: Where can I find Mennet Carkad?
faq.answer: You can find Mennet Carkad in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter, among covert operatives, trainers, and shadowcraft supplies.

faq.q: Who gives the quest to seek out Mennet Carkad?
faq.answer: Marion Call sends you to find Mennet Carkad from Brill's Gallows' End Tavern. She has noticed your growing skills and warns that Carkad expects prompt obedience.

faq.q: What comes after reporting to Mennet Carkad?
faq.answer: Reporting to Mennet Carkad leads directly into service for the Deathstalkers. Your first duties are meant to prove your cunning and loyalty to the Forsaken cause.

angles.text: As a rogue, you answer a summons that marks your passage from unproven cutpurse to recognized asset of the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's elite shadow network.
As an undead, you know the Deathstalkers help keep the Forsaken alive. They hunt Scarlet zealots and Scourge remnants, and protect Queen Sylvanas from hidden threats.
